an7.9:1.1: Sattannaṃ bhikkhave saññojanānaṃ pahānāya samucchedāya brahmacariyaṃ vussati.
an7.9:1.3: Anunayasaññojanassa pahānāya samucchedāya brahmacariyaṃ vussati, paṭighasaññojanassa . . . pe . . .
an7.9:1.9: Imesaṃ kho bhikkhave sattannaṃ saññojanānaṃ pahānāya samucchedāya brahmacariyaṃ vussati.
an7.9:1.10: Yato kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno anunayasaññojanaṃ pahīnaṃ hoti ucchinnamūlaṃ tālāvatthukataṃ anabhāvakataṃ āyatiṃ anuppādadhammaṃ,
an7.9:1.16: avijjāsaññojanaṃ pahīnaṃ hoti ucchinnamūlaṃ tālāvatthukataṃ anabhāvakataṃ āyatiṃ anuppādadhammaṃ:
an7.9:1.17: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu acchejji taṇhaṃ vivattayi saññojanaṃ sammāmānābhisamayā antam akāsi dukkhassā ti. X. 1. Satt'
